newsitem.title: CHINA: China warns Zhejiang Phoenix for irregularity.
newsitem.headline: China warns Zhejiang Phoenix for irregularity.

text.p: China's top securities watchdog warned Zhejiang Phoenix Chemical Co Ltd, an A share company listed in Shanghai, for an illegal merger with an unlisted firm, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
A shareholders' meeting of the company, a chemical product maker in the eastern province of Zhejiang, last week approved the merger with Kangbaier Co, a Zhejiang pharmaceuticals maker.
The China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), in an urgent circular, said the merger violated securities rules, the newspaper said.
The rules say a listed firm must not merge with an unlisted firm before China promulgates relevant regulations. China currently has no securities law nor any rules governing such mergers.
The CSRC ordered the two companies to immediately stop any move towards a merger and gave a special warning to Zhejiang Phoenix Chemical, the newspaper said.

The newspaper quoted Zhao Qing, secretary to the company's board of directors as saying in an interview that the two firms had been discussing a merger for the past two years with the involvement of the local authorities.
It quoted Zhao as saying that there must have been some misunderstanding about the existing securities rules, but he did not elaborate.
